text:
tia: Quick report: onboarding Thespian's LoRA adapter (cust-thespian). Ran a merge+int4 smoke and saw spurious locale-token insertions and shorter outputs on long instructions. Attn @marc @alex.

marc: Can you drop the exact failing prompt and the token diffs? Might be adapter-added tokens.

tia: Failing example: 
User: Walk me through creating a delivery window policy for perishable items.
Assistant (fp16): ... Step 2: choose timezone, Step 3: set buffer times, Step 4: finalize.
Assistant (int4): ... Step 2: <LOC:es> Step 3: set buffer times ... (missing buffer details)

alex: That <LOC:es> smells like an adapter-introduced special token. I ran tokenizer.compare and saw an extra id at position 14 in merged model only.

ci-bot: /ci/9233: merge-smoke started by @tia. 3 fails: localized-insert, long-instruct-cut, rerank-flip. Logs: /ci/9233/logs.

marc: Quick triage: adapter tokenizer had a reserved token mapped to 50265. Merge appended instead of remapping. Proposed fix: force remap reserved tokens during merge.

tia: Repro steps:
```
python -m rwi.eval --customer thespian --adapter thespian-lora-v1 \
  --merge stitch --quant int4-pack-B --suites instruction,conv,regress --seed 13
```
Outputs: BLEU fp16 0.711 -> int4 0.674; avg_len -10%.

alex: I triggered a remap sweep: remap=yes fixed localized-insert but long-instruct still flaky. Could be KV-cache packing interaction.

marc: Plan: 1) Default merge to force-remap for adapters that introduce new tokens. 2) Rebuild tokenizer mapping and remerge. 3) Run prefix-only inference to check KV-cache. 4) If long-instruct persists, try adapter-rescale 0.65 or int8 pack.

ops-bot: Canary config draft: /ops/canaries/thespian-remap-v1.json awaiting approval.

cia-bot: (typo) ci-bot: /ci/9234: remap sweep complete: remap=yes -> localized-insert fixed, remap=yes+rescale=0.65 -> long-instruct pass on 9/10. See /ci/9234/results.json

tia: Good progress. I'll validate on the extended holdout overnight and post summary tomorrow. If stable, we'll roll canary for the customer on dedicated pool with fallback to fp16 if regressions appear.

marc: I'll open GH issue with diffs and repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4623 (attachments: token-diffs, logs).

tia: Thanks team. Ping here for pairing on KV-cache if needed. :white_check_mark:
